env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
go test -v -count=1 -tags logosejected -run 'TestEjectedGroupCancelLeavesNetworkReadToComplete$' logos/rt
stdout '--- PASS: TestEjectedGroupCancelLeavesNetworkReadToComplete'
stdout '^ok\s+logos/rt'
! stderr 'no tests to run'
! stdout 'no tests to run'

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/group_ejected_netio.lgo a/main.lgo
mkdir outsider
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/group_ejected_netio_outsider/launch.go outsider/launch.go
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/group_ejected_netio_outsider/go.mod outsider/go.mod
cd a
logos eject -o ../out
exists ../out/main.go
! exists ../out/main.lgo
cd ../out
exists $UPROOT1273/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1273/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.3 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1273/bin/go run .
cd ..

-- go.mod --
module example.com/groupejectednetio

go 1.27

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/groupejectedconsumer

go 1.27

require example.com/groupejectedoutsider v1.0.0

replace example.com/groupejectedoutsider v1.0.0 => ../outsider
